scope: Account-wide visible Claude Haiku rows overlapping the two initial randomized issue pairs; separately timed synthetic reviewer preflight is below.

reviewerPreflight.description: Three synthetic schema checks, not issue reviews.
reviewerPreflight.matching: model, input and output tokens, and completion time within three seconds; no request ID linkage

limitations: Account-wide visible rows can include unrelated activity or omit rows; matching input/cache totals does not establish individual or per-arm charges.
Displayed-row text deduplication can merge identical requests, and moving pagination can omit rows.
Streamed assistant output tokens are not equivalent to final gateway output counts; no output-token reconciliation is asserted.
Reviewer matches are candidates, not request-ID proof. Failed calls, late reconciliation, infrastructure and human labor remain unknown.
